text:
Priya: Heads up — AcmeCo enterprise launch targeted next month; we need an interlock for rollout of their priority features. Can we sketch a canary + flag plan?
Jonah: Short answer: yes. Proposal: feature-flag per feature -> staged cohorts: internal 100% devs -> 10% beta -> customer-specific slice (AcmeCo) -> broader ramp. Geo staging EU then NA. Rollback via global kill switch + per-customer opt-out.
Casey: Two quick constraints: 1) must define latency SLOs and observe during canary. 2) For low-latency endpoints prefer Dedicated pool canaries first (avoid noisy-hosting confounds).
Marta: Customer also asked for an in-product A/B so they can evaluate UX variants. They want experiment labels in the response payload for downstream analytics.
Priya: Agreed. We'll need flag metadata for each flag: owner, kill-switch id, telemetry hooks, canary cohorts, roll-forward criteria, and a tested fallback. Can someone paste a minimal config schema?
Sam: Quick config snippet that we can use as a template:
```json
{
  "flag_name": "acmeco-smart-complete",
  "owners": ["priya", "jonah"],
  "cohorts": ["internal", "beta", "acmeco", "public"],
  "start_percent": {"internal":100, "beta":10, "acmeco":5},
  "regions": ["eu","us"],
  "metrics": ["latency_p95_ms","error_rate","cost_per_1000_tokens"],
  "rollback_criteria": {"error_rate>0.5%":"kill","p95>500ms":"investigate"},
  "fallback_model": "smaller-variant",
  "canary_duration_minutes": 60
}
```
Jonah: Important: include a "fallback_model" and a routing_priority array so the runtime can swap to fallback variant automatically if SLOs violate. Also include a KV cache migration note if model variant changes caching behavior.
deploy-bot: Reminder: infra freeze window Thu 03/12 02:00-06:00 UTC — avoid major cutovers then.
Casey: Also: quantization or kernel-level changes can't be part of this canary. Those require a separate warmup/validation run on dedicated infra.
Marta: A/B specifics: use consistent hashing by tenant_id for assignment so AcmeCo traffic stays stable. Provide an opt-out param for the customer ops team. Telemetry events should include experiment_id and variant.
Priya: Draft launch criteria I propose: 1) telemetry signals stable for 2 consecutive canary windows (p95 < 350ms), 2) error_rate < 0.1%, 3) cost delta within agreed threshold (< +5%), 4) pass prompt-set QA (95% acceptance). Objections?
Sam: Add: KMS integration smoke pass and audit log verification for Private deployments (customer will require).
Jonah: I'll draft the rollout doc and PR with the flag and canary templates + runbook. Target: doc by EOD tomorrow. @Marta can you own the A/B tracking payload schema and example analytics dashboard?
Marta: Yep I got this. I'll include event names and sample dashboards. Note for runbook: explicit rollback steps = 1) flip flag off, 2) route affected traffic to fallback_model, 3) if persistent, failover to other region and page oncall.
Priya: :thumbsup: thanks all. Quick sync in 15 to align on owners and timelines.
Jonah: I'll bring the draft and sample flag JSON.
Casey: I'll add the Dedicated-canary run checklist and perf test commands (small snippet below):
```
# run perf harness
./perf_harness --model sm-variant --qps 200 --duration 10m --profile p95
```
Priya: Perfect. We'll capture this in the rollout doc and link to the test jobs.
Marta: One last ops note: we need a telemetry gate that can auto-block rollforward if any critical trace error spikes > threshold. I'll add that to the metrics list.
Sam: Ok closing loop — PR by Jonah, A/B schema by Marta, Dedicated checklist by Casey, smoke/KMS by Sam, rollout owner = Priya.
Priya: Great. See you in 15.
